rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP server for the Bags.fm trading platform providing 19 tools for Solana-based token operations. Supports swap quotes and execution with slippage protection, token launches with bonding curves, creator fee claiming and split configuration, trending token discovery, whale activity tracking, and portfolio management. All transactions are generated unsigned for user-side wallet signing, ensuring zero custody risk.
